about: Nigeria Democratic Congress candidates for the 2027 general election, researched from published news reports and INEC's published final lists. Every record imports as a draft for an admin to check and verify; nothing here is published automatically. Research metadata goes into the internal verification notes only.

candidates.biography: Peter Obi is a former Governor of Anambra State and was the Labour Party's presidential candidate in 2023. He joined the Nigeria Democratic Congress in May 2026 and was affirmed as its presidential candidate on 30 May 2026, when he named former Kano State Governor Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso as his running mate.
candidates.campaign_summary: Peter Obi is the NDC's presidential candidate for 2027 on a joint ticket with Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso. The party zoned its presidential ticket to the South for a single four-year term at its May 2026 national convention, and Obi was the only aspirant for the nomination.

missing: INEC final presidential list entry not read directly (reported by Leadership and Peoples Gazette)
official campaign website or social accounts
flags: Running mate Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso has no Vice President position in the model, so he is not imported

candidates.biography: Olufunso Adeshina Doherty is a Lagos politician. INEC's final list of governorship candidates names him as the NDC candidate for Lagos State.
candidates.campaign_summary: Funso Doherty formally accepted the NDC's nomination for the 2027 Lagos governorship election and appears on INEC's final governorship list as the party's candidate in Lagos.

flags: Earlier reports said another aspirant (Naheem Balogun) also claimed the ticket; INEC lists Doherty

candidates.campaign_summary: Akim Adebola Yusuf is listed by INEC as the NDC's governorship candidate for Oyo State in the 2027 election.

flags: INEC writes the name surname-first (Yusuf Akim Adebola); confirm preferred order

candidates.biography: Aminu Abdussalam Gwarzo served as Deputy Governor of Kano State under Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf before resigning. He is a close ally of Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso.
candidates.campaign_summary: Rabiu Musa Kwankwaso announced Aminu Abdussalam Gwarzo as the NDC's Kano governorship candidate for 2027 after Nasiru Gawuna accepted the Kano Central Senate ticket instead.

flags: Not on INEC's 10 Oct 2026 final governorship list for Kano; a later Blueprint report said he was cleared on review. Confirm INEC's current list before verifying

candidates.campaign_summary: Prof. Abdulmumin Yinka Ajia is listed by INEC as the NDC's governorship candidate for Kwara State in the 2027 election.

candidates.campaign_summary: Barr. Ibrahim Kashim Muhammad emerged as the NDC's consensus governorship candidate for Bauchi State and is listed by INEC as the party's candidate for 2027.

candidates.biography: Aishatu Dahiru Ahmed, widely known as Binani, is a former Senator for Adamawa Central and was the APC's governorship candidate in Adamawa in 2023. She left the APC, briefly joined the ADC, and joined the NDC in May 2026.
candidates.campaign_summary: Senator Aishatu Binani is listed by INEC as the NDC's governorship candidate for Adamawa State in 2027, her second run for the office. If elected she would be the state's first female governor.
INEC's final list names Michael Okon Enyong as the NDC's governorship candidate for Akwa Ibom State in 2027.

flags: Name conflict: the party's 5 Sept 2026 statement reported 'Babanta Michael Okon'; INEC lists 'Enyong Michael Okon'. Confirm the correct name before verifying

candidates.campaign_summary: Retired Rear Admiral Ibrahim Sanusi Kasim is the NDC's governorship candidate for Borno State, named in the party's September 2026 statement and on INEC's final list.

candidates.biography: Paulinus Igwe Nwagu was born in 1959 and holds a degree in political science. He was a councillor in Ezza North Local Government (1990-1993) and its council chairman (1999-2002), represented Ezza North/Ishielu in the House of Representatives from 2007 to 2011, and was elected Senator for Ebonyi Central in 2011 on the PDP platform.
candidates.campaign_summary: Senator Paulinus Igwe Nwagu is listed by INEC as the NDC's governorship candidate for Ebonyi State. In October 2026 he rejected calls for zoning and said he remained committed to contesting the election to the end.

flags: The party's 5 Sept 2026 statement had named Nwofe Boniface; INEC's final list and later reporting name Nwagu

candidates.campaign_summary: Chief Chinyeaka Ohaa is the NDC's governorship candidate for Enugu State on INEC's list. A rival aspirant, Prof. James Ene-Nwannaji, withdrew his court challenge to Ohaa's nomination in September 2026 and said he would work with him.

flags: A faction led by Johnpaul Anih held a parallel primary that produced Ene-Nwannaji; that faction's list is not imported

candidates.campaign_summary: Aminu Sani Dutse is the NDC's governorship candidate for Jigawa State, named in the party's September 2026 statement and on INEC's final list.

candidates.campaign_summary: Aliyu Ilu-Barde is the NDC's governorship candidate for Katsina State, named in the party's September 2026 statement and on INEC's final list.

candidates.biography: Jonathan Sunday Akuns, known by the title Galadiman Dafo, sought the PDP governorship ticket in Plateau State in 2022 before joining the NDC, where he opened the party's state congress in May 2026.
candidates.campaign_summary: Da Jonathan Sunday Akuns appears in INEC's document as the NDC's governorship candidate for Plateau State, with Jonathan Pwajok as running mate. His nomination is being challenged in court.

links.label: AllAfrica: Plateau NDC ticket in court

flags: On 28 Sept 2026 the Federal High Court in Jos restrained Akuns from presenting himself as the candidate pending a suit; Alfred Dapal also claims the ticket and the party once submitted Yakubu Ndam as a placeholder. Do not verify until the court position is checked

candidates.campaign_summary: Dr. Shamsuddeen Aliyu Haido is the NDC's governorship candidate for Sokoto State in 2027 and appears on INEC's final governorship list.

candidates.biography: Yahaya Mohammed Sani is a professor.
candidates.campaign_summary: Prof. Yahaya Mohammed Sani is the NDC's governorship candidate for Taraba State, named in the party's September 2026 statement and on INEC's final list.

candidates.biography: Kabiru Garba Marafa is a former senator who served in the 8th Senate.
candidates.campaign_summary: Senator Kabiru Marafa won the NDC's governorship ticket in Zamfara State in May 2026, when the party also named candidates for all 34 elective positions in the state. INEC lists him as the party's candidate.

candidates.biography: Deacon Chris Iyovwaye is a businessman. He sought the PDP governorship ticket in Delta State ahead of the 2023 election before joining the NDC.
candidates.campaign_summary: Deacon Chris Iyovwaye won the NDC's governorship primary in Delta State and campaigns on the message "Reset Delta". He opened his campaign headquarters in Asaba with Peter Obi and Ovie Omo-Agege, and argues that the state needs stronger institutions and an economy that creates opportunities for young people.
priorities: Tackle poverty, unemployment and insecurity in Delta State
Grow an economy that creates opportunities for young people

candidates.biography: Ovie Omo-Agege is a former Deputy President of the Senate and was the APC's governorship candidate in Delta State in 2023. He left the APC and joined the NDC on 28 May 2026.
candidates.campaign_summary: Senator Ovie Omo-Agege was granted a waiver by the NDC to contest the Delta Central Senatorial seat and won the party's primary. He has said he backs Peter Obi for president.

candidates.biography: Victor Ochei is a former Speaker of the Delta State House of Assembly. He left the APC for the NDC in May 2026.
candidates.campaign_summary: Rt. Hon. Victor Ochei was granted a waiver by the NDC to contest the Delta North Senatorial seat and is the party's candidate there.
Adowei Binaebi is reported as the NDC's candidate for Delta South Senatorial District and attended the opening of the party's governorship campaign headquarters in Asaba.

candidates.biography: Nasiru Sule Garo is a former lawmaker.
candidates.campaign_summary: The NDC affirmed Nasiru Sule Garo as its candidate for Kano North Senatorial District in August 2026 after the earlier nominee, Sunusi Danbatta, withdrew voluntarily and pledged his support.

flags: Substitution candidate; confirm INEC accepted the substitution

candidates.biography: Nasiru Yusuf Gawuna served as Deputy Governor of Kano State under Governor Abdullahi Umar Ganduje and was the APC's governorship candidate in Kano in 2023. He joined the NDC in May 2026.
candidates.campaign_summary: Dr. Nasiru Yusuf Gawuna is the NDC's candidate for Kano Central Senatorial District. The incumbent senator, Rufa'i Sani Hanga, stepped aside so that Gawuna could take the ticket, which Rabiu Kwankwaso announced in May 2026.

flags: Conflicting reports: one said he was preparing to defect to the APC; a later report said he insisted on staying in the NDC while some allies left. Confirm he is still the candidate

candidates.biography: Chief Santus Ofana is an agro-industrialist and the founder of the Ogoja Rice brand.
candidates.campaign_summary: Santus Ofana won the NDC primary for Ogoja/Yala Federal Constituency with 395 votes across both councils, ahead of five other aspirants. He has called for unity between Ogoja and Yala and says the constituency needs representation that attracts federal projects.
priorities: Create opportunities for young people and women

flags: He publicly rebutted claims challenging the primary result

candidates.biography: Olayemi Toviho, popularly known as OBJ, sought the Badagry House of Representatives seat on the PDP platform in 2022.
candidates.campaign_summary: Hon. Olayemi Toviho was returned unopposed as the NDC's House of Representatives candidate for Badagry Federal Constituency. He says he wants to give the constituency quality representation and practical development.

candidates.biography: Afam Victor Ogene was born on 12 March 1963 in Anambra State. He represented Ogbaru in the House of Representatives from 2011 to 2015 and won the seat again in 2023 on the Labour Party platform. He leads the NDC caucus in the House and moved the motion that zoned the party's 2027 presidential ticket to the South.
candidates.campaign_summary: Hon. Afam Ogene, the incumbent member for Ogbaru, emerged as the NDC's consensus candidate for the constituency at the party's National Assembly primary held in Atani on 29 May 2026.
The NDC elected Chidi Mike Anyanwu as its candidate for the Okigwe North Federal Constituency seat in the House of Representatives.

candidates.biography: Engr. Azubuike Emmanuel Umeadi has chaired the Kirikiri Lighter Terminal chapter of the National Association of Government Approved Freight Forwarders. He left the ADC for the NDC in 2026.
candidates.campaign_summary: Engr. Azubuike Umeadi won the NDC House of Representatives primary for Amuwo Odofin Federal Constituency, defeating the outgoing member, George Adegeye. He describes his mandate as one for genuine representation, development and empowerment.

flags: The reported vote totals (about 40,000) look large for a primary; check the result before verifying

candidates.campaign_summary: Chijioke Onyeneke won the NDC primary for the Owerri federal constituency with 111 votes, ahead of Philip Ejiogu with 11. He says he will give priority to security, education, youth empowerment, jobs, healthcare and economic growth.

flags: Source says 'Owerri federal constituency'; the INEC name is assumed to be Owerri Municipal/Owerri North/Owerri West - confirm

candidates.biography: Edwin Anayo Nwonu is a former member of the House of Representatives who represented Ezza North/Ishielu for eight years. He says he supported pupils and students in the constituency through scholarships, learning materials and payment of examination fees.
candidates.campaign_summary: Edwin Anayo Nwonu is the NDC's candidate for Ezza North/Ishielu Federal Constituency. He is seeking to return to the House, saying the constituency needs effective representation, and has promised to expand his education support if elected.
priorities: Expand scholarships and support for examination fees
